name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Spellseeker's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: whenever Spellseeker's triggered ability would trigger
other: Spellseeker's oracle text: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

Requires Spellseeker to have power 2 or less at the time of the trigger (Delney's ability text: "Creatures you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater. If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.") - both cards confirm this at their printed base power, but power can change from effects elsewhere in the deck (e.g. -1/-1 counters, boosts); not checked against every other card's interaction with this power threshold.
Effectively doubles tutor density off one card when Delney is out - relevant to Phase 25 tutor-network analysis (each of the two finds still costs a separate reveal but no extra mana).

result.summary: Spellseeker's ETB tutor trigger fires twice, finding up to two instant/sorcery cards with mana value 2 or less from a single Spellseeker resolution instead of one.

sources.reference: Independent pairwise scan of card_cache oracle text against Delney's triggered-ability-doubling clause, 2026-08-12 (not indexed as a formal combo by Commander Spellbook - this is a value multiplier, not a win line).
